blockers.description: Exact feature/tutorial bodies are not split into heading/task/recipe byte ranges with per-slice hashes.
All exact tree paths are inventoried, but other site-page, image, and generated-HTML bodies remain metadata-only.
The exact documentation build has not been reproduced.
Exact binary/menu/help, configuration, POTCAR, and accepted parent VASP evidence are not covered by the docs authority.

vaspkit-exact-documentation-tree-invento.title: VASPKIT exact documentation-repository tree metadata inventory

limitations: Two exact raw pages are hash-verified, and the full docs tree is path/object inventoried, but the remaining page bodies, semantic heading slices, build replay, exact binary, private configuration, POTCAR, and parent VASP evidence remain external.
The inventory identity binds the exact pre-migration catalog bytes as migration metadata; it does not identify any upstream document body.

binary-and-parent-vasp-closure-external.description: Exact VASPKIT binary/menu/help, binary usage terms, platform profile, private configuration, POTCAR libraries, and accepted parent VASP data are separate external authorities.

documentation-build-not-replayed.description: The Sphinx/source-to-generated-site build has not been reproduced from the exact commit.

exact-page-bodies-not-retained.description: The exact features/tutorial Git objects were hash-verified and byte-counted but their bodies are not stored.

other-site-page-bodies-not-retained.description: The complete exact documentation tree is inventoried, but installation, changelog, citations, gallery, images, generated HTML, and other page bodies remain metadata-only.

semantic-heading-slices-not-materialized.description: Feature/task and tutorial/recipe subjects are mapped to whole-page receipts; heading-level exact byte ranges and slice hashes are not materialized.
